messages:
Zoe: hypothetically: our smallest LLM opens a coffee cart. what does it brew? :coffee:
Hector: 'Context Cappuccino'  adds micro-hints on the foam. :sparkles:
Yara: 'PatchPal Pour-over'  filters out noisy inputs, very artisanal. :herb:
Zoe: BlendBot: poll created -> Options: Context Cappuccino, PatchPal Pour-over, MicroBarista Espresso Shots, Concierge Cold Brew. Vote with :one: - :four:.
BlendBot: Poll results: 1) Context Cappuccino 2) Concierge Cold Brew 3) MicroBarista Espresso Shots 4) PatchPal Pour-over
Hector: vote for cold brew. slow and reliable like our cache. :ice_cube:
Yara: also idea: merch sticker 'I survived a 2-token latte' for internal swag.
Zoe: design note: onboarding easter egg: when embed latency < 50ms show tiny coffee cup GIF. harmless morale booster.
Hector: sample off-hours persona prompt for demos: ```system: off_hours=true; adopt playful barista voice; answers are 6 tokens max; include one coffee pun if possible.```
Yara: tried a variant in a demo and someone asked if the model takes tips. we said yes, in cookies. :cookie:
ops-bot: reminder: animated assets for internal demos allowed; customer-facing assets require brand and legal signoff.
Zoe: ok leaving this thread before it becomes a product spec. PTO-appropriate banter complete. :wave:
